apocalypse/22/18.text: For l teſtifie to euery one hearing the vvordes of the prophecie ofthis booke,ᶠ If any mā ſhal adde to theſe things. God ſ hal adde vpon him the plagues vvritten in this booke.

apocalypse/22/19.text: And ifany man ſhal diminiſ h of the wordes ofthe booke of this prophecie: God ſhal take avvay his part out of the booke of life, and out of the holy citie, and of theſe thinges that be vvritten in this booke.

apocalypse/22/20.text: ſaith he that giueth teſti¬ monie of theſe things. Yea I come quickely: Amen.q Come

apocalypse/22/21.text: The grace of our Lord IES vs Chriſt be vvith you al. Amen.
